pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā sandiṭṭhā sambhattā bhikkhū Vaggumudāya nadiyā tīre vassaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena Vajjī dubbhikkhā hoti dvīhitikā setaṭṭhikā salākāvuttā na sukarā uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.4: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi: etarahi kho Vajjī dubbhikkhā dvīhitikā . . . yāpetuṃ. kena nu kho mayaṃ upāyena samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vaseyyāma na ca piṇḍakena kilameyyāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.5: ekacce evam āhaṃsu: handa mayaṃ āvuso gihīnaṃ kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhema, evan te amhākaṃ dātuṃ maññissanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.6: evaṃ mayaṃ samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasissāma na ca piṇḍakena kilamissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.7: ekacce evam āhaṃsu: alaṃ āvuso kiṃ gihīnaṃ kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhitena,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.8: handa mayaṃ āvuso gihīnaṃ dūteyyaṃ harāma, evan te amhākaṃ dātuṃ maññissanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.9: evaṃ mayaṃ samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasissāma na ca piṇḍakena kilamissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.10: ekacce evam āhaṃsu: alaṃ āvuso kiṃ gihīnaṃ kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhitena, kiṃ gihīnaṃ dūteyyaṃ haṭena,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.11: handa mayaṃ āvuso gihīnaṃ aññamaññassa uttarimanussadhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsissāma
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.12: asuko bhikkhu paṭhamassa jhānassa lābhī, asuko bhikkhu dutiyassa jhānassa lābhī, asuko bhikkhu tatiyassa jhānassa lābhī, asuko bhikkhu catutthassa jhānassa lābhī, asuko bhikkhu sotāpanno, asuko bhikkhu sakadāgāmī, asuko bhikkhu anāgāmī, asuko bhikkhu arahā, asuko bhikkhu tevijjo, asuko bhikkhu chaḷabhiñño 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.14: evaṃ mayaṃ samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasissāma na ca piṇḍakena kilamissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.15: eso yeva kho āvuso seyyo yo amhākaṃ gihīnaṃ aññamaññassa uttarimanussadhammassa vaṇṇo bhāsito 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.16: atha kho te bhikkhū gihīnaṃ aññamaññassa uttarimanussadhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsiṃsu:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.17: asuko bhikkhu paṭhamassa jhānassa lābhī --pa-- asuko bhikkhu chaḷabhiñño 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.18: atha kho te manussā lābhā vata no suladdhaṃ vata no yesaṃ no evarūpā bhikkhū vassaṃ upagatā, na vata no ito pubbe evarūpā bhikkhū vassaṃ upagatā yatha yime bhikkhū sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.19: te na tādisāni bhojanāni attanā bhuñjanti mātāpitūnaṃ denti puttadārassa denti dāsakammakaraporisassa denti mittāmaccānaṃ denti ñātisālohitānaṃ denti yādisāni bhikkhūnaṃ denti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.20: na tādisāni khādaniyāni sāyaniyāni pānāni attanā pivanti mātāpitūnaṃ denti puttadārassa denti dāsakammakaraporisassa denti mittāmaccānaṃ denti ñātisālohitānaṃ denti yādisāni bhikkhūnaṃ denti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.1.21: atha kho te bhikkhū vaṇṇavanto ahesuṃ pīnindriyā pasannamukhavaṇṇā vippasannachavivaṇṇā. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.1: āciṇṇam kho pan' etaṃ vassaṃ vutthānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.2: atha kho te bhikkhū vassaṃ vutthā temāsaccayena senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Vesālī ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.3: anupubbena yena Vesālī Mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgārasālā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.5: tena kho pana samayena disāsu vassaṃ vutthā bhikkhū kisā honti lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.6: Vaggumudātīriyā pana bhikkhū vaṇṇavanto honti pīnindriyā pasannamukhavaṇṇā vippasannachavivaṇṇā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.7: āciṇṇaṃ kho pan' etaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.8: atha kho bhagavā Vaggumudātīriye bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.10: kacci samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasittha na ca piṇḍakena kilamitthā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.12: samaggā ca mayaṃ bhante sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasimhā na ca piṇḍakena kilamimhā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.13: jānantāpi tathāgatā pucchanti, jānantāpi na pucchanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.14: kālaṃ viditvā pucchanti, kālaṃ viditvā na pucchanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.17: dvīh' ākārehi buddhā bhagavanto bhikkhū paṭipucchanti dhammaṃ vā desessāma sāvakānaṃ vā sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.18: atha kho bhagavā Vaggumudātīriye bhikkhū etad avoca: yathākathaṃ pana tumhe bhikkhave samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasittha na ca piṇḍakena kilamitthā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.19: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.20: kacci pana vo bhikkhave bhūtan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.23: kathañ hi nāma tumhe bhikkhave udarassa kāraṇā gihīnaṃ aññamaññassa uttarimanussadhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.24: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.25: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:1.2.26.1: yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannassa uttarimanussadhammaṃ āroceyya, bhūtasmiṃ pācittiyan ti. ||2||1||

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc8:2.5.59: tena bhikkhunā suññāgāre catutthaṃ jhānaṃ sacchikatan ti bhaṇantassa āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||5||
